## Claims

- OUH Odense Surgical Department A conducted an internal audit and implemented measures with increased focus on steroid tapering and improved dialogue about acute patients with partner hospitals [^src1] ([[odense-kirurgisk-afdeling-a|Odense Kirurgisk Afdeling A]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]])
- Region Nordjylland will focus on correct registration practices for the proportion of newly diagnosed patients receiving education within one year of diagnosis [^src1] ([[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]])
- Region Nordjylland wishes to increase its target for indicator 4 regarding DEXA scanning in patients over 50 years old receiving steroid treatment for IBD [^src1] ([[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]])
- Region Nordjylland plans to enable nurses and secretaries in the Department of Gastrointestinal Diseases to order DEXA scans and will attempt to retroactively register and order DEXA scans for patients included in the 2025 annual report [^src1] ([[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]])
